name: infrabooth-downloader
title: InfraBooth Downloader
description: Search SoundCloud, download links and control the InfraBooth Downloader desktop player from Raycast.
author: kandid

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search SoundCloud
commands.description: Search SoundCloud tracks and playlists and send them to InfraBooth Downloader.

commands.name: now-playing
commands.title: Now Playing
commands.description: See the track playing in InfraBooth Downloader and control playback, shuffle, volume and the queue.

commands.name: download-link
commands.title: Download SoundCloud Link
commands.description: Paste a SoundCloud track, playlist or album link and download it with InfraBooth Downloader.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
